select.$description: Tokens of `select`: its control, besides those of `field`, and its options, besides those of `listbox`.

gap.$description: Space between the selected option's label and the chevron.

chevron-size.$description: Width and height of the chevron. Its stroke is twice the border's width.

placeholder-color.$description: Text color of the placeholder, while no option is selected.

selected-font-weight.$description: Font weight of the selected option, in the list.
